correctness.rationale: The independent edge Poisson rate is 1/a+1/b and gives exact rates (b-l)h c and (a-h)l c. The rescaled generator converges to a unique finite-jump PDMP with drift h/a and intensity (a-h)y/a. Hub absorption is tight on the \(b^{-1/2}\) scale, leaving \(b-o_{\mathbb P}(b)\) susceptible leaves. Their post-hub exponential clocks have independent rate 1+a/b, yielding a Gumbel limit independent of the early path. The first-extra-hub exact law is the minimum of b independent two-stage exponential sums; its quadratic small-time expansion proves Rayleigh scaling. 15 independent rational labeled/lumped checks, 14 rational first-hub moment identities and 48 transient-survival comparisons passed. No finite check is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The fixed-width complete bipartite broadcast process has two distinct scales. It is not enough to know a generic order-logarithmic completion bound: the early finite hub community activates at scale \(b^{-1/2}\) with a path-dependent pure-jump limit, while terminal leaf completion has an independent extreme-value limit. The explicit Rayleigh first-hub law, joint PDMP limit and independent Gumbel give a natural, reusable probabilistic description in a nonregular family, relevant to epidemic spread and graph first-passage models.
